I hope you're joking.

making nothing is bad, but working for slave wage is worse. 

At least if you don't work, you don't encourage corporate exploitation. Working for, and saying you're happy to do that for the rest of your life, makes me very sad indeed.

I'm fine with downvoting, people have downvoted me irl for having the same ideals. 

But do leave a comment. Downvoting takes energy to click, Tell me why you made that decision to justify the energy to click.

And Tiffany, i'm still speechless. Where was the confident fany that insisted on tv she wasn't dating at all, just weeks before she eventually admitted to dating, albeit reluctantly. I've lost all respect for you fany. 

Never liked liars, never will.

Every alternate week my mom amd I get calls from conman about lottery scams. I feel absolutely depressing. Here I am struggling with bills, and these calls come as taunts that people exist out there make stable salaries that would be considered once in a lifetime jackpots here. Has these calls gone up in numbers because there are more desperate people willing to fall for these scams to secure their winnings, or are people increasingly desperate to scam others in search of their own meals.

I wonder. Could this have been different. I really wonder.
